blockingFindings.title: R8 matrix coverage is incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: R8 is an explicit acceptance requirement and has no corresponding complete spec-local coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests cover required failures for throw, ok:false, malformed result, and artifact write failure, but advisory behavior is only exercised for a thrown error. Success cases and advisory ok:false, malformed result, and artifact/context write failure are not covered, despite R8 requiring the required/advisory matrix for all listed outcomes.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable cases that exercise both required and advisory policies for success, throw, ok:false, malformed result, and artifact/context write failure.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R8 is an explicit acceptance requirement and has no corresponding complete spec-local coverage.

blockingFindings.title: R1 missing-policy rejection is not tested
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for the missing-policy branch.
blockingFindings.issue: R1 requires discovered hooks and persisted snapshot entries to reject a missing failure policy, but the test only checks a valid discovered policy, an unknown discovered policy, and an invalid snapshot policy. There is no missing-policy rejection case for registration or snapshot loading.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add tests that omit failurePolicy from a discovered hook and from a snapshot entry and assert rejection before hook execution.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for the missing-policy branch.

blockingFindings.title: R5 integrity hard-failure cases are largely uncovered
blockingFindings.rationale: Critical integrity behavior required by R5 has no regression coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: R5 lists import failure, invalid register(api), invalid FlowCommandHook inheritance, missing snapshot module, and snapshot metadata mismatch as hard failures. The current test only checks invalid snapshot policy, which is not one of those listed integrity cases.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable tests for each R5 integrity failure category, or at minimum representative cases that directly prove these integrity failures remain hard failures regardless of policy.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Critical integrity behavior required by R5 has no regression coverage.

blockingFindings.title: R6 command atomicity is tested by source-text regex only
blockingFindings.rationale: This is a static anti-pattern that can pass without exercising production behavior, and R6 requires command-level atomicity coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: The R6 test reads plugin-registry.js and matches a broad regex around required and main(). This can pass without exercising prepare or finalize-cleanup, and it does not verify that spec source, draft, flow state, issue-log, plugin artifact files, teardown transaction, finalize commit, worktree, feature branch, last-finalized-spec, or active flow state remain unchanged.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Replace or supplement the regex with executable command-level tests for prepare and finalize-cleanup that induce a required pre-hook failure and assert the listed durable side effects do not occur.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a static anti-pattern that can pass without exercising production behavior, and R6 requires command-level atomicity coverage.

blockingFindings.title: R7 structured outcome usage is only checked by absence of one warning-scan string
blockingFindings.rationale: R7 requires caller behavior, but the test encodes a brittle implementation premise and can pass without exercising production behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: The R7 test only asserts that one exact PLUGIN_HOOK_FAILED find() expression is absent from run-finalize-cleanup.js. It does not execute run-prepare-spec or run-finalize-cleanup, does not prove they consume the structured runner outcome, and can pass if warning scanning is rewritten in another form.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable tests that drive required lifecycle failure through run-prepare-spec and run-finalize-cleanup and assert they consume the structured failure outcome and stop before teardown/main work.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R7 requires caller behavior, but the test encodes a brittle implementation premise and can pass without exercising production behavior.

blockingFindings.title: R4 data and follow-up preservation is incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: Required preservation behavior in R4 lacks direct regression coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: R4 requires advisory business failures to preserve warning, issue-log, and follow-up information while continuing, and successful advisory or required hooks to preserve hook data and follow-ups. The current advisory test checks warning and issue-log entries for a thrown error only, and does not check follow-ups or successful hook data/follow-up preservation for either policy.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add tests for advisory failure follow-up preservation and successful required/advisory hook data plus follow-up preservation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Required preservation behavior in R4 lacks direct regression coverage.
